 Print Rajasthan United FC are set to return to their home ground, Vidhyadhar Nagar Stadium, Jaipur, as they prepare to face Chanmari FC in their upcoming IFC outing on Friday Jaipur: Rajasthan United FC are set to return to their home ground, Vidhyadhar Nagar Stadium, Jaipur, as they prepare to face Chanmari FC in their upcoming Indian Football League (IFL) 2026-27 fixture on Friday. The match is scheduled to kick off at 3pm. Following their first victory of the campaign, the Desert Warriors will look to carry forward the positive momentum and secure another valuable three points in front of their home supporters. With confidence growing within the squad, Rajasthan United will be eager to deliver a strong performance and make the most of home advantage against a determined Chanmari FC side. Speaking ahead of the encounter RUFC chairperson KK Tak said, “Our return to Vidhyadhar Nagar Stadium is an important occasion for the entire Rajasthan United family. Following our recent victory, the team is determined to build on that momentum and continue its fight for valuable points in the league. We have immense faith in our players and coaching staff, and we look forward to seeing them give their best against Chanmari FC. I also extend my heartfelt gratitude to all our distinguished guests for accepting our invitation and being part of this special occasion. Their presence and encouragement mean a great deal to the club and reflect the growing support for football in Rajasthan. We invite all our supporters and football enthusiasts to join us at the stadium, stand behind our Desert Warriors and make this home fixture a memorable one.” Rajasthan United FC are set to return to their home ground, Vidhyadhar Nagar Stadium, Jaipur, as they prepare to face Chanmari FC in their upcoming IFC outing on Friday The upcoming home fixture will also be marked by the presence of several distinguished guests. The club is honoured to welcome chief guest Dr Arun Chaturvedi, chairperson of the Rajasthan State Finance Commission, along with guest of honour Ramprasad, senior pracharak and RSS patron. The distinguished guests will be joined by special guests Subhash Goyal, president, Jaipur Vyapar Mahasangh and member, National Traders Welfare Board, Government of India; Raju Agarwal Mangodiwala, president, Jewellers Association, Jaipur; Heeralal Nagar, Minister of State (Independent Charge), Energy Department, Government of Rajasthan; and Praveen Gupta, Additional Chief Secretary (IAS), Public Works Department and Additional Chief Secretary, Youth Affairs and Sports Department, Government of Rajasthan. The occasion will also be attended by Ravindra Panchal, Senior Strategic adviser and PRO, RUFC, alongside KK Tak, chairperson, Rajasthan United FC, and Roshni Tak, Director, Rajasthan United FC. Rajasthan United FC are set to return to their home ground, Vidhyadhar Nagar Stadium, Jaipur, as they prepare to face Chanmari FC in their upcoming IFC outing on Friday Ahead of the fixture, Rajasthan United FC also organised a news conference featuring assistant coach Anil Tomar and midfielder Judah Garcia, who shared their thoughts on the team’s preparations, the importance of the upcoming encounter and their expectations for the remainder of the season. Speaking at the news conference, assistant coach Anil Tomar expressed his happiness at being back with Rajasthan United FC, saying, “It’s good to be back at Rajasthan United FC, a club that has always been close to my heart. I have some wonderful memories from my previous time here, and returning after five years brings back a lot of emotions. Football is all about relationships, experience and memories, so I am looking forward to a new chapter and a new challenge. It’s a great responsibility and an exciting opportunity for me. The Indian Football League is a competitive platform, and being entrusted with Rajasthan United is something I truly value personally. The preparations have been positive. The players have been working hard in training, and we have been focusing on our tactical approach according to the match. My message to the players is simple: believe in yourself, trust your teammates and give everything on the pitch because tomorrow we have three points to fight for. Every player must give their hundred per cent. Our supporters are a very important part of the club. They encourage us and give the players extra motivation. I request everyone to come to the stadium, watch the match and give their full support to Rajasthan United.” Player, Judah Garcia also spoke about the team’s renewed confidence following their recent victory and the importance of approaching every fixture with the aim of securing three points. He stated, “For me, we don’t look at the standings right now because the league has just started. It’s very important to approach every game one by one and aim to get all three points. I think the guys are really excited, and we have been doing the necessary work in training to do everything possible to secure another victory in the next match. Personally, my goal is to achieve the targets I have set for myself for the remainder of the season. To all the Rajasthan United supporters, I would like to encourage you to come in numbers to the stadium and support us so that we can give our best on the pitch. I would also like to invite everyone to the stadium to watch exciting football.” Rajasthan United FC look forward to welcoming the Jaipur football community back to the stadium as the Desert Warriors prepare for another important league encounter.
